summary_1line: Rama surveys Lanka and arranges his army while Shuka reports the monkeys’ brutality to Ravana, who defiantly refuses to return Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands with Lakshmana on a height gazing at the banner-covered golden city of Lanka rising on the mountain like palaces in the clouds.
Vast ranks of monkeys armed with boulders and uprooted trees march toward Lanka like a mass of storm clouds.
The battered spy Shuka, wings bound and body bruised, trembles before Ravana’s throne while the demon king glares with burning red eyes.
